cities.name: Sofia
cities.local_food_tip: Ćevapi, banica, tarator (hladna čorba), shopska salata — ukus balkanske kuhinje sa bugarskim štihom.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🕍 Alexander Nevsky Cathedral: Impresive Orthodox basilica with golden domes. → 🚶 Walk through the pedestrian zone and old boulevards. → ☕ Coffee & banitsa in the historic center.

Afternoon: 🏛️ National History Museum or Archaeological Museum → 🍽️ Lunch: Shopska salad, grilled meat or traditional kachamak (corn porridge). → 🌄 Walk up to Vitosha Boulevard for city‑plus‑mountain panorama.

Sunset: 🌅 Borisova Gradina park or Vitosha mountain viewpoint — golden hour over Sofia and hills.

Night: 🌃 Trendy cafés and street‑art corners in Lozenets or Studentski Grad — casual urban vibe.

ideas: 🌸 Walks through Tsar’s Garden and tree‑lined boulevards in bloom.
🎨 Street‑art tours in neighborhoods like Oborishte.
☕ Outdoor cafés on pedestrian streets coming alive after winter.
🏞️ Short hike to Vitosha Mountain — fresh air above the city.
🌇 Evening stroll along Vitosha Boulevard — lively and warm.
🍦 Ice cream in historic center after museum visits.
🍁 Borisova Gradina park with golden leaves and calm walks.
🥟 Trying hearty local dishes in cozy taverns as weather cools.
🏛️ Indoor museum visits (History or Art) on rainy or chilly days.
❄️ Snow‑covered Vitosha panorama nights — city lights + mountain outline.
☕ Warm drinks & tradicionalna jela u lokalnim kafanama.
🎄 Christmas market in the center with festive lights and sweets.

public_transport_tips: 🚇 Metro connects main districts quickly — ideal for first visits.
🚍 Buses and trams available — check So‑Mobi or Google Maps for schedules.
🚶 Historic center is compact and walkable — great for sightseeing on foot.
🎟️ Day or weekend pass can save money za obilazak više lokacija.

city_events.name: Sofia Summer Fest
city_events.description: 🎶 Open‑air concerts, street performances and youth‑oriented culture programme.

city_events.name: Urban Art Walk
city_events.description: 🎨 Street‑art festival and creative workshops around the city.

city_events.name: Sofia Christmas Market
city_events.description: 🎄 Festive stalls, handmade crafts and traditional food in city center.

cities.name: Plovdiv
cities.local_food_tip: Kebapche, meshana skara (mixed grill), banitsa, baklava — ukus lokalnih taverni i sokaća.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏺 Ancient Roman Theatre: Walk through history and enjoy city views from the stage. → 🕰️ Kapana creative district: colorful houses, craft shops and street art. → ☕ Coffee break in a boho café.

Afternoon: 🏙️ Stroll through Old Town — narrow alleys, revival‑era houses and small art galleries. → 🍽️ Lunch: Meshana skara and shopska salad in a traditional kafana. → 📸 Walk up to Nebet Tepe or Alyosha Hill for panorama over Plovdiv.

Sunset: 🌇 Walk alongMaritsa river embankment, relax by the water.

Night: 🎶 Live music in local bars or chill in cozy taverns — relaxed vibe for younger posetioce.

ideas: 🌷 Old Town gardens and blooming bougainvillea around Kapana.
🚶 Pleasant walks on Maritsa embankment with mild weather.
🎨 Outdoor art markets and small festivals.
🌠 Outdoor concerts in Roman Theatre under the stars.
🍨 Ice‑cream and late evening strolls around Old Town.
🌇 Sunset from Hills — golden light over terracotta roofs.
🍁 Warm colours on hills around city — photogenic walks.
🥟 Hearty local meals in taverns as temperatures drop.
🏛️ Visiting museums and galleries during cooler afternoons.
❄️ Foggy dawns and atmospheric Old Town streets.
☕ Hot drinks in quaint cafés tucked between historic houses.
🛍️ Winter sales in craft shops — souvenirs and handmade gifts.

public_transport_tips: 🚍 Local buses connect suburbs and old town easily.
🚶 Old Town i Kapana su najbolje istraživati pešice.
🎫 Day ticket is povoljan za obilazak muzeja i raznih delova grada.
📱 Korišćenje Google Maps‑a pomaže da planiraš rute i prelazak između zona.

city_events.name: Kapana Fest
city_events.description: 🎨 Ulična umetnost, živa muzika i kreativni štandovi kroz kvart Kapana.

city_events.name: Plovdiv Autumn Art Week
city_events.description: 🖼️ Izložbe, galerije i kulturni događaji u starom gradu.

cities.name: Varna
cities.local_food_tip: Sveža riba, plodovi mora, lukanka, tarator — mediteranski sastojci uz crnomorski šarm.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🌅 Sunrise walk on the seafront promenade → 🐚 Visit to Naval Museum or Archaeological Museum. → ☕ Breakfast in café by the beach.

Afternoon: 🏖️ Beach time at Golden Sands or Sveti Konstantin → 🍽️ Lunch: grilled fish & shopska salad. → 🚶 Relaxing stroll through Sea Garden and coastal paths.

Sunset: 🌇 Swim or chill on the shore — enjoy golden hour over the Black Sea.

Night: 🌃 Seaside promenades, gelato or drink near the beach, bars with seaside view — relaxed letnji ugođaj.

ideas: 🌸 Promenada uz more sa svežom, prolećnom klimom.
🖼️ Museums and indoor attractions pre letnje sezone.
☕ Cafés sa pogledom na obalu — mir i opuštanje.
🏖️ Dugi dani na plaži — plivanje, sunčanje i sportovi na vodi.
🌅 Večernje šetnje i kupovina u primorskim radnjama.
🎶 Letnji festivali, barovi i koncerti pod zvezdama.
🍁 Šetnje uz talase, opušteni dani pre zime.
🥘 Riblje večere u lokalnim tavernama uz svežu hranu.
📸 Fotografisanje zalaska sunca iznad mora — spektakularno.
🌬️ Šetnje uz vetrovito more i prazne plaže — mir i refleksija.
☕ Topli napici u obalnim kafeima sa pogledom na tamno more.
🎄 Blagdanski ugođaj u centru – božićne svetiljke i lokalne pijace.

public_transport_tips: 🚍 Gradsku mrežu autobusa i trolejbusa koristi za prelazak od centra do plaža.
🚶 Obalna šetališta i centar su lako dostupni pešice.
🚆 Vozovi ili autobusi povezuju Varna sa drugim primorskim mestima i sela.
🎟️ Letnje kombinovane karte (prevoz + plaža) mogu biti isplative.

city_events.name: Varna Summer Fest
city_events.description: 🎶 Muzika, open‑air događaji i zabava uz obalu Crnog mora.

city_events.name: Autumn Sea Nights
city_events.description: 🌊 Večernje šetnje i riblje večere uz more u prijatnoj jesenskoj atmosferi.

cities.name: Veliko Tarnovo
cities.local_food_tip: Banica, meso‑na‑ražnju, lokalna vina i domaći sirevi — rustični i domaći ukusi planinskog kraja.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🌄 Visit to Tsarevets Fortress — walk through stone towers and history. → 📸 Panoramic view from Trapezitsa or hills around the city. → ☕ Coffee in cobblestone streets of Samovodska Charshiya (old crafts quarter).

Afternoon: 🏘️ Explore old‑town alleys, wooden‑roofed houses and small artisan shops. → 🍽️ Lunch: Traditional Bulgarian dishes and local wine in a tavern. → 🌳 Walk along Yantra river bank — peaceful and scenic.

Sunset: 🌅 Sunset over the fortress and river — one of the most photogenic spots in Bulgaria.

Night: 🌌 Small local bars, acoustic music or calm evening stroll — intimate atmosphere.

ideas: 🌸 Green hills around fortress — priroda u cvatu, idealno za šetnju.
🖼️ Artisan shops u staroj čaršiji sa ručnim radom i suvenirima.
🚶 Walks kroz istorijske ulice pre sezone turista.
🏰 Dnevne ture po Tsarevetsu + večernji svetlosni efekti na zidinama.
🌇 Večernje šetnje pored reke i mirna atmosfera gradskih ulica.
📷 Noćna fotografija — crveni krovovi i rečni odbljesci.
🍁 Zlatni listovi na padinama oko grada — topla, nostalgična atmosfera.
🥘 Kusanjе domaćih jela i lokalnih vina u tavernama.
🌙 Večernje šetnje u kamenom starom gradu unutar svetla lampe.
❄️ Hladno, tiho i spokojno — manje turista, više lokalnog ritma.
🔥 Domaći ručkovi uz vatru i vino u starim tavernama.
🕯️ Zimski večernji šetnje kroz istorijske ulice — mistično i mirno.

public_transport_tips: 🚌 Autobusi i mini‑vansovi od Sofije ili Plovdiva su česta opcija za dolazak.
🚶 Centar i stari grad su kompaktni i lako dostupni pešice.
🚗 Ako planiraš izlete do okolnih planina — rent a car je zgodan.
🎫 Lokalni kombi‑prevoz (maršrutke) je povoljan za okolna sela i planinske staze.

city_events.name: Tsarevets Sound & Light Show
city_events.description: 🎇 Večernji multimedijalni spektakl na zidinama srednjovekovne tvrđave.

city_events.name: Autumn Wine & Culture Week
city_events.description: 🍷 Degustacija lokalnih vina, izložbe i koncerti u starom gradu.

cities.name: Bansko
cities.local_food_tip: Kachamak, stews, grilled meats, lokalna rakija — planinska domaća hrana koja greje i daje energiju.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🚠 Cable car / gondola ride into :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1} → 🥾 Hiking or easy strolls on marked forest paths. → ☕ Mountain café or chalet with a view.

Afternoon: 🏞️ Explore mountain meadows or alpine lakes (season permitting) → 🍽️ Lunch: hearty stew, soup or grilled meat. → 📸 Scenic photos of peaks and valleys.

Sunset: 🌄 Return to town — enjoy golden light on traditional tiled roofs and wooden chalets.

Night: 🔥 Warm fireplace in a guesthouse, traditional live folk‑music, or night stroll through quiet village lanes.

ideas: 🌱 Hiking trails open — planinske livade cvetaju, savršeno za prirodu.
🚶 Šetnje kroz selo i susedna planinska sela sa mirnim ritmom.
🛖 Domaći doručak uz predele punog zelenila i čistog vazduha.
🥾 Duži planinski izleti i kampovanje u Pirinu.
🌌 Noći pod zvezdama i tišina prirode — beg od gradske vrućine.
🍦 Seoske poslastice i sveže mlečne proizvode za osveženje.
🍁 Zlatne i crvene boje šuma oko planinskih staza — savršeno za pešačenje.
🥘 Tradicionalne večere sa domaćom hranom i rakijom.
📷 Fotografisanje prelepih jesenjih pejzaža i sela.
⛷️ Ski & snowboard na Pirinu — snežni dani i planinska atmosfera.
🔥 Večeri uz kamin, domaću hranu i lokalnu muziku u planinskim kolibama.
🕯️ Romantične noćne šetnje kroz snegom pokriveno selo.

public_transport_tips: 🚍 Direktni busovi iz Sofije na dan — dobra opcija za putnike bez automobila.
🚶 Selo je kompaktno i lako istraživo pešice.
🚡 Gondola do planinskih staza štedi vreme i energiju.
🚗 Ako planiraš obilazak okolnih planina — kombi ili rent a car je zgodan.

city_events.name: Bansko Jazz Festival
city_events.description: 🎷 Međunarodni muzički festival — jazz, world music i letnja atmosfera u planinskom gradu.

city_events.name: Winter Ski Opening Party
city_events.description: 🎿 Otvaranje sezone skijanja, s popustima, zabavom i zimskom energijom.
